products.description: The Scarlet Letter is generally considered to be Nathaniel Hawthornes masterpiece. Set in 17th century Boston, it follows the plight of Hester Prynne, a young woman who bears a child out of wedlock, refuses to name the father, and is condemned to wear a scarlet A for the rest of her life. With The Scarlet Letter, Hawthorne reaches back to Americas Puritan roots to probe themes of lust, sin, guilt and redemption.
